concept: Instance Scheduler / EventBridge: stopping EC2 outside business hours
tests: How to automatically stop dev instances outside working hours to save money with minimal effort.
expected: AWS Instance Scheduler or EventBridge scheduled rules (+ Lambda/SSM) to stop/start on a schedule. Triggers: "only during business hours", "Mon–Fri 8–18", "automatically stop outside hours", "minimal effort".
why_not: Spot and RIs are pricing models, they don't turn instances off; manual stopping — unreliable and not automatic.
